ALWAYS use this script to send email; never hand-build `curl … -d "{…}"` with inline `jq`/shell interpolation (that silently produces empty "Message from Recoup" footer-only emails). Pairs with recoup-platform-api-access (which it sends through). 4: --- 5: 6: # Sending email from a task 7: 8: Send email by running the bundled Node script — **do not** assemble JSON in the shell. 9: 10: ## Why this exists 11: 12: Hand-rolling the send (`curl -sS … -d "{… \"html\": $(echo "$HTML" | jq -R -s '.') …}"`) is fragile: depending on quoting/escaping it produces a **malformed body**, and the API used to silently deliver an empty footer-only email titled **"Message from Recoup"** with `success:true`. Write the email body to a file (recommended for HTML — avoids all escaping issues): 17: 18: ```bash 19: cat > /tmp/report.html <<'HTML' 20:

Daily Report

21:

…your real content…

22: HTML 23: ``` 24: 25: 2. Prefer `--html-file`. | 42: | `--text-file ` / `--text ` | Plain-text body. | 43: | `--to ` | Recipient (repeatable). **Omit to default to the account's own email** ("email me this"). | 44: | `--cc ` | CC (repeatable). | 45: | `--chat-id ` | Room id for the footer "continue the conversation" link. | 46: | `--dry-run` | Serialize + validate and print the payload; do **not** send. Use to preview. | 47: 48: ## Rules 49: 50: - **Exactly one body is required.** The script **refuses to send** (exit code 2) if there is no non-empty `--html`/`--text`. Never try to send an empty email. 51: - **Check the exit code.** Non-zero means it did **not** send — read stderr and fix it; do not report success. The script prints the Resend message id on a real send. 52: - The script reads `RECOUP_API_KEY` / `RECOUP_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `RECOUP_API_BASE` from the environment — these are already set in the sandbox. Never print or hard-code them. 53: - Node only (the sandbox runtime is `node22`; `python3` is not guaranteed). Zero dependencies."}}
